get_config_file: get the local path to a Detectron2 model zoo config file by its relative config path
get_config: get a Detectron2 config object for a model zoo model, optionally with trained weights set
get_checkpoint_url: get the S3 download URL for a pretrained Detectron2 model given its config path
get: get a fully built Detectron2 model from the model zoo with pretrained weights loaded
query_model_urls: query the _ModelZooUrls class to look up pretrained model URLs by config path name
